entities.summary: Justin David Hawkins is an English musician, Internet personality, singer, and songwriter best known as the founder, lead singer, and lead guitarist of The Darkness, of which his younger brother Dan is also a member. He is also the lead singer and guitarist for the band Hot Leg, formed in 2008 and now on hiatus. In 2021, Hawkins launched a YouTube channel entitled Justin Hawkins Rides Again, where he does comedic analysis on songs or artists in addition to covering news in the musical community. Hawkins has been widely praised for his musical abilities, particularly his voice which spans five octaves.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Justin Hawkins' musical career has had a significant impact on the contemporary music scene in Northern Europe, particularly with his work as the lead singer and guitarist of The Darkness and Hot Leg. His YouTube channel, Justin Hawkins Rides Again, has also contributed to the discussion of musical trends and analysis.
